---- MODULE W4Od16m6p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

\* A pharmacy dispenser cabinet is protected by a time-bound lease: only the
\* current, valid, non-crashed lease holder may dispense. A holder can crash
\* silently while still holding the lease; the lease later expires and is
\* reclaimed on its own, regardless of whether its holder is still alive.

CONSTANTS Pharmacists

VARIABLES owner, leaseValid, crashed, dispenser

vars == <<owner, leaseValid, crashed, dispenser>>

TypeOK == /\ owner \in Pharmacists \cup {"none"}
          /\ leaseValid \in BOOLEAN
          /\ crashed \in BOOLEAN
          /\ dispenser \in Pharmacists \cup {"none"}

Init == /\ owner = "none"
        /\ leaseValid = FALSE
        /\ crashed = FALSE
        /\ dispenser = "none"

\* Any pharmacist may take an unowned lease; it starts fresh and valid.
Acquire(p) == /\ owner = "none"
              /\ owner' = p
              /\ leaseValid' = TRUE
              /\ crashed' = FALSE
              /\ dispenser' = "none"

\* Only the current, valid, non-crashed holder may dispense.
Dispense(p) == /\ owner = p
               /\ leaseValid
               /\ ~crashed
               /\ dispenser' = p
               /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseValid, crashed>>

\* The current holder silently stops responding without releasing the lease.
Crash(p) == /\ owner = p
            /\ leaseValid
            /\ ~crashed
            /\ crashed' = TRUE
            /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, leaseValid, dispenser>>

\* The lease's validity window lapses on its own, crashed or not.
Expire == /\ owner # "none"
          /\ leaseValid
          /\ leaseValid' = FALSE
          /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, crashed, dispenser>>

\* The system reclaims an already-expired lease, freeing it for anyone.
Release == /\ owner # "none"
           /\ ~leaseValid
           /\ owner' = "none"
           /\ crashed' = FALSE
           /\ dispenser' = "none"
           /\ UNCHANGED leaseValid

Next == \/ \E p \in Pharmacists : Acquire(p) \/ Dispense(p) \/ Crash(p)
        \/ Expire
        \/ Release

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ WF_vars(Expire) /\ WF_vars(Release)

\* No stale dispenser is ever left on record for someone who isn't the holder.
Authorized == (dispenser # "none") => (dispenser = owner)

\* A silently crashed holder's lease is always eventually reclaimed.
LivenessRecovery == crashed ~> (owner = "none")

====

This spec models a pharmacy's controlled-substance dispenser, whose cabinet is protected by a time-bound lease: only the pharmacist currently holding a valid, unexpired lease is authorized to dispense from it. The action set is: Acquire, in which any pharmacist takes the lease when the cabinet is currently unowned, becoming its sole authorized holder with a freshly valid lease and no crash recorded; Dispense, in which the current lease holder - provided their lease is still valid and they have not silently crashed - draws medication from the cabinet, and the system records them as the most recent authorized dispenser; Crash, in which the current lease holder silently stops responding without releasing the lease or notifying anyone, after which they can no longer dispense; Expire, in which the current lease's validity window lapses on its own regardless of whether its holder is still responsive, representing the passage of time; and Release, in which the pharmacy system reclaims an already-expired lease, clearing its ownership (and any crash flag) so that another pharmacist becomes free to acquire it. A pharmacist who has silently crashed keeps holding the lease until it naturally expires and is reclaimed - no one dispenses on their behalf in the meantime.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the system's record of the most recent authorized dispenser is non-empty, that record names exactly the cabinet's current lease holder (no stale or unauthorized dispenser is ever left on record for someone who is not the current holder).
LIVENESS PROPERTY: Whenever the current lease holder has silently crashed, the cabinet's lease is eventually reclaimed and made ownerless again, even though the crashed holder never releases it themselves.

---- MODULE W4Od17m9p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

\* A baggage-sorting buffer's capacity can be reconfigured at runtime through
\* a bounded run of numbered configuration epochs. A reconfiguration only
\* takes effect (bumping the epoch) when the newly proposed capacity would
\* not immediately be violated by the bags already sitting in the buffer.

CONSTANTS MaxCap, MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat \ {0}
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, capacity, buffered, targetCapacity

vars == <<epoch, capacity, buffered, targetCapacity>>

TypeOK == /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
          /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
          /\ buffered \in 0..MaxCap
          /\ targetCapacity \in 0..MaxCap

\* Free room left under the buffer's currently configured capacity.
Headroom == capacity - buffered

Init == /\ epoch = 0
        /\ capacity = MaxCap
        /\ buffered = 0
        /\ targetCapacity = MaxCap

RouteIn == /\ buffered < capacity
           /\ buffered' = buffered + 1
           /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, targetCapacity>>

RouteOut == /\ buffered > 0
            /\ buffered' = buffered - 1
            /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, targetCapacity>>

\* The control plane may propose a new capacity value at any time; this alone
\* changes nothing about the buffer's actual current capacity.
ProposeCapacity(c) == /\ c \in 0..MaxCap
                      /\ targetCapacity' = c
                      /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, buffered>>

\* A proposed reconfiguration installs only if it would not immediately be
\* violated by what is already buffered, and the epoch budget is not spent.
ApplyReconfig == /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
                 /\ targetCapacity # capacity
                 /\ targetCapacity >= buffered
                 /\ capacity' = targetCapacity
                 /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
                 /\ UNCHANGED <<buffered, targetCapacity>>

Next == \/ RouteIn
        \/ RouteOut
        \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : ProposeCapacity(c)
        \/ ApplyReconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The buffer never holds more bags than its currently configured capacity,
\* even as that capacity is repeatedly reconfigured at runtime.
CapacityInvariant == buffered <= capacity

\* Before any reconfiguration has ever been applied, capacity is still the
\* original value the buffer was configured with at epoch zero.
ReconfigCoherent == (epoch = 0) => (capacity = MaxCap)

THEOREM Spec => []TypeOK

nl:
This spec models an airport baggage router whose sorting buffer has a runtime-reconfigurable capacity, tracked through a sequence of numbered configuration epochs. The action set is: RouteIn, which moves one more bag onto the sorting buffer whenever there is still room under the buffer's current capacity; RouteOut, which removes one bag from the sorting buffer (for example, onto a connecting belt), always available whenever the buffer is non-empty; ProposeCapacity, in which the router's control plane proposes a new capacity value for the buffer at any time, without yet changing anything; and ApplyReconfig, which - only when the proposed capacity is different from the buffer's current capacity, is not below the number of bags presently sitting in the buffer, and the epoch counter has not exhausted its bounded run of configuration changes - actually installs the proposed value as the buffer's new capacity and advances the configuration to the next numbered epoch. Because ApplyReconfig refuses to install a proposed capacity that is smaller than the number of bags already in the buffer, a runtime capacity change can shrink the buffer's limit but never below what is currently occupying it.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of bags sitting in the sorting buffer never exceeds the buffer's currently configured capacity, even as that capacity is repeatedly reconfigured at runtime.

---- MODULE W4Od16m6p5t0 ----
\* Pharmacy dispensing stations use expiring leases to claim a prescription
\* before performing the one irreversible step: actually dispensing it.
\* Lease "time left" is a bounded countdown (not an absolute clock), so a
\* crashed station's stale lease always has a finite path to lapsing.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Stations, Prescriptions, NoStation, LeaseLen

VARIABLES leaseHolder, leaseTicksLeft, dispensed, timesDispensed, crashed

vars == <<leaseHolder, leaseTicksLeft, dispensed, timesDispensed, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ leaseHolder \in [Prescriptions -> Stations \union {NoStation}]
  /\ leaseTicksLeft \in [Prescriptions -> 0..LeaseLen]
  /\ dispensed \subseteq Prescriptions
  /\ timesDispensed \in [Prescriptions -> 0..2]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Stations

Init ==
  /\ leaseHolder = [p \in Prescriptions |-> NoStation]
  /\ leaseTicksLeft = [p \in Prescriptions |-> 0]
  /\ dispensed = {}
  /\ timesDispensed = [p \in Prescriptions |-> 0]
  /\ crashed = {}

AcquireLease(s, p) ==
  /\ s \notin crashed
  /\ p \notin dispensed
  /\ (leaseHolder[p] = NoStation \/ leaseTicksLeft[p] = 0)
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![p] = s]
  /\ leaseTicksLeft' = [leaseTicksLeft EXCEPT ![p] = LeaseLen]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dispensed, timesDispensed, crashed>>

\* The one irreversible step: only the current, not-yet-lapsed lease holder may do it.
Dispense(s, p) ==
  /\ leaseHolder[p] = s
  /\ s \notin crashed
  /\ p \notin dispensed
  /\ leaseTicksLeft[p] > 0
  /\ dispensed' = dispensed \union {p}
  /\ timesDispensed' = [timesDispensed EXCEPT ![p] = @ + 1]
  /\ leaseHolder' = [leaseHolder EXCEPT ![p] = NoStation]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseTicksLeft, crashed>>

\* Advances the shared countdown clock, lapsing any lease whose time has run
\* out. Always enabled (a no-op once nothing is outstanding) so the clock
\* never gets stuck even after every prescription has been dispensed.
Tick ==
  /\ leaseTicksLeft' = [p \in Prescriptions |->
                          IF leaseTicksLeft[p] > 0 THEN leaseTicksLeft[p] - 1
                          ELSE 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, dispensed, timesDispensed, crashed>>

\* Exactly one station may ever go silent; its lease is left to lapse normally.
Crash(s) ==
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ crashed' = crashed \union {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseTicksLeft, dispensed, timesDispensed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Stations, p \in Prescriptions : AcquireLease(s, p)
  \/ \E s \in Stations, p \in Prescriptions : Dispense(s, p)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Crash(s)

Fairness ==
  /\ \A s \in Stations, p \in Prescriptions : WF_vars(AcquireLease(s, p))
  /\ \A s \in Stations, p \in Prescriptions : SF_vars(Dispense(s, p))
  /\ WF_vars(Tick)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ Fairness

AtMostOnceDispensed == \A p \in Prescriptions : timesDispensed[p] <= 1

EventuallyDispensed == \A p \in Prescriptions : <>(p \in dispensed)

====

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
  Stations = {s1, s2}
  Prescriptions = {p1, p2}
  NoStation = NoStation
  LeaseLen = 1
INVARIANT AtMostOnceDispensed
PROPERTY EventuallyDispensed
nl: A small hospital pharmacy uses a bank of dispensing stations to fill prescriptions. Each prescription can be worked by at most one station at a time: a station must first acquire a lease on a prescription before it is allowed to dispense the medication, and every lease carries a fixed countdown of remaining ticks before it lapses. The AcquireLease action lets a station take charge of a prescription whenever nobody currently holds a live lease on it (either the prescription has never been claimed, or the previous holder's lease has already counted down to zero). The Dispense action lets the station that currently holds a live, not-yet-lapsed lease actually hand the medication to the patient; this is the one irreversible step in the whole process, and once it happens for a prescription the lease is released. The Tick action advances the shared countdown clock by one unit, ticking down the remaining time on every outstanding lease that still has time left; this is what eventually lets a stalled lease lapse so another station can take over. The Crash action lets exactly one dispensing station go silent at any point: once crashed, that station can never acquire a new lease or dispense anything again, but any lease it was already holding is simply left to lapse on the shared countdown like any other lease, rather than being cleaned up specially. Because at most one station is ever allowed to crash, and the surviving stations keep working, the queue keeps moving even after the failure. SAFETY PROPERTY: no prescription is ever actually dispensed to a patient more than once. LIVENESS PROPERTY: every prescription is eventually dispensed, even if the station that first leased it crashes silently.

---- MODULE W4Od6m8p5t0 ----
\* Elevator dispatch with a coarse (zone) lock, then a fine (car) lock inside
\* it -- each zone has exactly one dedicated car, referenced by the zone's
\* own id. Committing a car's trip is the one irreversible step here.
\* A silently crashed dispatcher just leaves whatever locks it held stuck.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Dispatchers, Zones, NoDispatcher

VARIABLES zoneLock, carLock, commitCount, committedBy, crashed

vars == <<zoneLock, carLock, commitCount, committedBy, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ zoneLock \in [Zones -> Dispatchers \union {NoDispatcher}]
  /\ carLock \in [Zones -> Dispatchers \union {NoDispatcher}]
  /\ commitCount \in [Zones -> 0..2]
  /\ committedBy \in [Zones -> Dispatchers \union {NoDispatcher}]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Dispatchers

Init ==
  /\ zoneLock = [z \in Zones |-> NoDispatcher]
  /\ carLock = [z \in Zones |-> NoDispatcher]
  /\ commitCount = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
  /\ committedBy = [z \in Zones |-> NoDispatcher]
  /\ crashed = {}

AcquireZoneLock(d, z) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ zoneLock[z] = NoDispatcher
  /\ zoneLock' = [zoneLock EXCEPT ![z] = d]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<carLock, commitCount, committedBy, crashed>>

AcquireCarLock(d, z) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ zoneLock[z] = d
  /\ carLock[z] = NoDispatcher
  /\ carLock' = [carLock EXCEPT ![z] = d]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, commitCount, committedBy, crashed>>

\* The one irreversible step: a committed car can never be recommitted.
CommitTrip(d, z) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ carLock[z] = d
  /\ commitCount[z] = 0
  /\ commitCount' = [commitCount EXCEPT ![z] = @ + 1]
  /\ committedBy' = [committedBy EXCEPT ![z] = d]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, carLock, crashed>>

ReleaseCarLock(d, z) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ carLock[z] = d
  /\ carLock' = [carLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoDispatcher]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, commitCount, committedBy, crashed>>

\* Coarse lock only gives up once the fine lock inside it has already gone.
ReleaseZoneLock(d, z) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ zoneLock[z] = d
  /\ carLock[z] # d
  /\ zoneLock' = [zoneLock EXCEPT ![z] = NoDispatcher]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<carLock, commitCount, committedBy, crashed>>

\* Exactly one dispatcher may ever go silent; its locks are simply abandoned.
Crash(d) ==
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ crashed' = crashed \union {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneLock, carLock, commitCount, committedBy>>

\* A no-op status check that keeps at least one action enabled from any
\* reachable state (as long as one dispatcher has not crashed).
Inspect(d) ==
  /\ d \notin crashed
  /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers, z \in Zones : AcquireZoneLock(d, z)
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers, z \in Zones : AcquireCarLock(d, z)
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers, z \in Zones : CommitTrip(d, z)
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers, z \in Zones : ReleaseCarLock(d, z)
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers, z \in Zones : ReleaseZoneLock(d, z)
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers : Crash(d)
  \/ \E d \in Dispatchers : Inspect(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TripCommittedAtMostOnce ==
  \A z \in Zones :
    /\ commitCount[z] <= 1
    /\ (committedBy[z] # NoDispatcher <=> commitCount[z] = 1)

====
nl: A skyscraper's elevator bank is split into zones, and each zone is served by exactly one dedicated car, tracked under that zone's own identifier. Dispatchers coordinate trips using a two-level, coarse-then-fine locking scheme: a dispatcher must first take the coarse lock on a whole zone before it is allowed to touch anything inside that zone, and only then may it take the fine lock on that zone's car. The AcquireZoneLock action lets an idle dispatcher take the coarse lock on a zone that nobody else currently holds. The AcquireCarLock action lets a dispatcher that already holds a zone's coarse lock take the fine lock on that zone's car, provided nobody else currently holds it. The CommitTrip action lets the dispatcher holding a car's fine lock lock in that car's next destination and send it on its way; this is the one irreversible step in the whole protocol, since a trip that has already been committed can never be recommitted or reassigned. The ReleaseCarLock action lets a dispatcher give up the fine lock on a car it holds. The ReleaseZoneLock action lets a dispatcher give up the coarse lock on a zone, but only once it is no longer holding the fine lock on that zone's car, respecting the coarse-then-fine ordering in reverse. The Crash action lets exactly one dispatcher go silent at any point, silently abandoning whatever locks it was holding; those locks are never released, but the other dispatcher can still work every zone the crashed one never touched. The Inspect action lets any dispatcher that has not crashed perform a routine status check that changes nothing, so the bank always has something to do even if every lock is stuck or every car has already been committed. SAFETY PROPERTY: no elevator car ever has its trip committed more than once, and a car counts as committed exactly when it has an owning dispatcher on record.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m5p3t5 ----
\* Opening-auction clearing slots are claimed either by quorum vote among
\* matching-engine nodes, or once, directly, by an admin override. Either
\* path is one-shot per slot: nothing may claim an already-claimed slot.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Slots, Stocks, NoStock, Quorum

VARIABLES proposedStock, votes, allocated, allocCount

vars == <<proposedStock, votes, allocated, allocCount>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ proposedStock \in [Slots -> Stocks \union {NoStock}]
  /\ votes \in [Slots -> SUBSET Nodes]
  /\ allocated \in [Slots -> Stocks \union {NoStock}]
  /\ allocCount \in [Slots -> 0..2]

Init ==
  /\ proposedStock = [s \in Slots |-> NoStock]
  /\ votes = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
  /\ allocated = [s \in Slots |-> NoStock]
  /\ allocCount = [s \in Slots |-> 0]

\* Puts forward a candidate stock for a still-unclaimed, uncontested slot.
Propose(n, slot, stock) ==
  /\ allocated[slot] = NoStock
  /\ proposedStock[slot] = NoStock
  /\ proposedStock' = [proposedStock EXCEPT ![slot] = stock]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![slot] = {n}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<allocated, allocCount>>

\* Adds one more node's vote in favor of a slot's pending candidate.
Vote(n, slot) ==
  /\ allocated[slot] = NoStock
  /\ proposedStock[slot] # NoStock
  /\ n \notin votes[slot]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![slot] = @ \union {n}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposedStock, allocated, allocCount>>

\* The irreversible claim, once a quorum of nodes has voted for the candidate.
Finalize(slot) ==
  /\ allocated[slot] = NoStock
  /\ proposedStock[slot] # NoStock
  /\ Cardinality(votes[slot]) >= Quorum
  /\ allocated' = [allocated EXCEPT ![slot] = proposedStock[slot]]
  /\ allocCount' = [allocCount EXCEPT ![slot] = @ + 1]
  /\ proposedStock' = [proposedStock EXCEPT ![slot] = NoStock]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![slot] = {}]

\* The privileged shortcut: skips voting entirely, but still one-shot per slot.
AdminOverride(slot, stock) ==
  /\ allocated[slot] = NoStock
  /\ allocated' = [allocated EXCEPT ![slot] = stock]
  /\ allocCount' = [allocCount EXCEPT ![slot] = @ + 1]
  /\ proposedStock' = [proposedStock EXCEPT ![slot] = NoStock]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![slot] = {}]

\* A no-op audit that keeps at least one action enabled once every slot has
\* been claimed (by quorum or by override), so the model never deadlocks.
Audit == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, slot \in Slots, stock \in Stocks : Propose(n, slot, stock)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, slot \in Slots : Vote(n, slot)
  \/ \E slot \in Slots : Finalize(slot)
  \/ \E slot \in Slots, stock \in Stocks : AdminOverride(slot, stock)
  \/ Audit

\* Liveness is driven only by the quorum path: propose, vote, finalize.
\* AdminOverride is left unfair -- an extra safe option, not a progress crutch.
Fairness ==
  /\ \A slot \in Slots : WF_vars(\E n \in Nodes, stock \in Stocks : Propose(n, slot, stock))
  /\ \A n \in Nodes, slot \in Slots : WF_vars(Vote(n, slot))
  /\ \A slot \in Slots : WF_vars(Finalize(slot))

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ Fairness

NoDoubleAllocation ==
  \A slot \in Slots :
    /\ allocCount[slot] <= 1
    /\ (allocated[slot] # NoStock <=> allocCount[slot] = 1)

EverySlotEventuallyAllocated == \A slot \in Slots : <>(allocated[slot] # NoStock)

====
nl: A stock exchange runs an opening auction with a small number of fixed clearing slots, each of which can end up matched to at most one listed stock for that morning's open. A committee of matching-engine nodes decides which stock gets which slot by voting: the Propose action lets any node put forward a stock as the candidate for a still-unclaimed slot, as long as that slot has no candidate pending yet, and it casts the proposer's own vote in favor. The Vote action lets any other node add its vote in favor of the slot's current candidate, as long as that node has not already voted on this round and the slot has not already been claimed. The Finalize action lets the slot's candidate become the slot's actual, irreversible allocation once enough nodes (a quorum) have voted for it, clearing the pending vote so nothing further can attach to that slot. The AdminOverride action lets a privileged exchange administrator claim any still-unclaimed slot for a stock directly, skipping the vote entirely and wiping out any pending candidate and votes for that slot, but even the administrator cannot touch a slot that has already been claimed. The Audit action lets the committee perform a routine, no-op status check that changes nothing, so there is always something for the exchange to do even after every slot has already been claimed. SAFETY PROPERTY: no clearing slot is ever claimed for more than one stock, whether the claim came from reaching quorum or from the administrator's override. LIVENESS PROPERTY: every clearing slot is eventually claimed by some stock through the normal proposal-and-quorum process.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m6p4t5 ----
\* Library holds are leases with a bounded countdown: a hold either lapses
\* (ExpireHold) or converts to a checkout (CheckOut) before the copy is
\* returned (Return). AdminOverride grants a checkout directly, but capacity
\* is still enforced against the very same shared counter.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Patrons, TotalCopies, LeaseLen

VARIABLES reserved, checkedOut, ticksLeft, activeHolds

vars == <<reserved, checkedOut, ticksLeft, activeHolds>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ reserved \in [Patrons -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ checkedOut \in [Patrons -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ ticksLeft \in [Patrons -> 0..LeaseLen]
  /\ activeHolds \in 0..Cardinality(Patrons)

Init ==
  /\ reserved = [p \in Patrons |-> FALSE]
  /\ checkedOut = [p \in Patrons |-> FALSE]
  /\ ticksLeft = [p \in Patrons |-> 0]
  /\ activeHolds = 0

\* Places a hold, only if the title is not already at full capacity.
Reserve(p) ==
  /\ ~reserved[p]
  /\ ~checkedOut[p]
  /\ activeHolds < TotalCopies
  /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ ticksLeft' = [ticksLeft EXCEPT ![p] = LeaseLen]
  /\ activeHolds' = activeHolds + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED checkedOut

\* Converts a still-live hold into an actual checkout; capacity is unchanged.
CheckOut(p) ==
  /\ reserved[p]
  /\ ~checkedOut[p]
  /\ ticksLeft[p] > 0
  /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ checkedOut' = [checkedOut EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ticksLeft, activeHolds>>

\* Advances the shared countdown clock. Always enabled, even as a no-op.
Tick ==
  /\ ticksLeft' = [p \in Patrons |->
                     IF reserved[p] /\ ticksLeft[p] > 0
                     THEN ticksLeft[p] - 1
                     ELSE ticksLeft[p]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, checkedOut, activeHolds>>

\* A hold whose countdown ran out lapses, freeing its copy.
ExpireHold(p) ==
  /\ reserved[p]
  /\ ticksLeft[p] = 0
  /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ activeHolds' = activeHolds - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<checkedOut, ticksLeft>>

\* Bringing the book back frees its copy.
Return(p) ==
  /\ checkedOut[p]
  /\ checkedOut' = [checkedOut EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ activeHolds' = activeHolds - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, ticksLeft>>

\* The privileged shortcut: still refused once the title is at full capacity.
AdminOverride(p) ==
  /\ ~reserved[p]
  /\ ~checkedOut[p]
  /\ activeHolds < TotalCopies
  /\ checkedOut' = [checkedOut EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ activeHolds' = activeHolds + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, ticksLeft>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Patrons : Reserve(p)
  \/ \E p \in Patrons : CheckOut(p)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E p \in Patrons : ExpireHold(p)
  \/ \E p \in Patrons : Return(p)
  \/ \E p \in Patrons : AdminOverride(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected ==
  /\ activeHolds <= TotalCopies
  /\ activeHolds = Cardinality({p \in Patrons : reserved[p] \/ checkedOut[p]})

====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
  Patrons = {p1, p2, p3}
  TotalCopies = 2
  LeaseLen = 1
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl: A small branch library owns a fixed number of copies of a popular title. Patrons who want the book go through a lease-based hold system: the Reserve action lets an idle patron place a hold on a copy, provided the library is not already at full capacity for that title, and starts a countdown on how long the hold will be honored before it lapses. The CheckOut action lets a patron whose hold has not yet lapsed convert that hold into an actual checkout of the book, without changing how many copies are considered spoken for. The Tick action advances the shared countdown clock, ticking down the time remaining on every patron's outstanding hold that still has time left; this is always available even when nothing is outstanding, so the branch's clock never gets stuck. The ExpireHold action lets a patron's hold lapse once its countdown reaches zero, freeing up the copy it was holding for someone else. The Return action lets a patron who has checked out the book bring it back, likewise freeing up a copy. The AdminOverride action lets a privileged librarian check the book out directly to an idle patron, skipping the hold-and-countdown process entirely, but even the librarian is refused if the title is already at full capacity. SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of copies simultaneously spoken for, whether by an active hold or an actual checkout, never exceeds the number of copies the library owns, and that count always matches exactly the patrons who are currently holding or holding-and-checked-out.

---- MODULE W4Od3m3p3t5 ----
\* Interbank settlement coordination via leader election with failover: a
\* settlement node campaigns to become coordinator, may step down at any
\* time (forcing re-election), and only the current coordinator may commit
\* a settlement slot -- an irreversible, one-shot-per-slot action. An admin
\* override can also commit a slot directly, bypassing the election.
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Slots, NoLeader, AdminTag, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES leader, epoch, committedBy, commitCount

vars == <<leader, epoch, committedBy, commitCount>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \union {NoLeader}
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ committedBy \in [Slots -> Nodes \union {AdminTag, NoLeader}]
  /\ commitCount \in [Slots -> 0..2]

Init ==
  /\ leader = NoLeader
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ committedBy = [s \in Slots |-> NoLeader]
  /\ commitCount = [s \in Slots |-> 0]

\* Any node may become coordinator whenever the role is open; the epoch
\* counter tracks the term but is capped -- it never gates an action.
Campaign(n) ==
  /\ leader = NoLeader
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch
  /\ UNCHANGED <<committedBy, commitCount>>

\* The coordinator may give up the role at any time, triggering failover.
StepDown ==
  /\ leader # NoLeader
  /\ leader' = NoLeader
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, committedBy, commitCount>>

\* The one irreversible step: only the sitting coordinator may take it, and
\* only for a slot nobody has committed yet.
CommitSlot(n, slot) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ committedBy[slot] = NoLeader
  /\ committedBy' = [committedBy EXCEPT ![slot] = n]
  /\ commitCount' = [commitCount EXCEPT ![slot] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch>>

\* The privileged shortcut: skips the election, but still refused on a slot
\* that has already been committed.
AdminOverride(slot) ==
  /\ committedBy[slot] = NoLeader
  /\ committedBy' = [committedBy EXCEPT ![slot] = AdminTag]
  /\ commitCount' = [commitCount EXCEPT ![slot] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Campaign(n)
  \/ StepDown
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, slot \in Slots : CommitSlot(n, slot)
  \/ \E slot \in Slots : AdminOverride(slot)

\* Liveness is driven only by the election-and-commit path: campaigning and
\* committing are strongly fair, so repeated failovers cannot stall a slot
\* forever. StepDown and AdminOverride are left unfair, adversarial options.
Fairness ==
  /\ \A n \in Nodes : SF_vars(Campaign(n))
  /\ \A n \in Nodes, slot \in Slots : SF_vars(CommitSlot(n, slot))

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars /\ Fairness

NoDoubleCommit ==
  \A slot \in Slots :
    /\ commitCount[slot] <= 1
    /\ (committedBy[slot] # NoLeader <=> commitCount[slot] = 1)

EverySlotEventuallyCommitted == \A slot \in Slots : <>(committedBy[slot] # NoLeader)

====

nl: A consortium of banks runs a shared interbank settlement system that processes a handful of fixed settlement-batch slots each night. Only one bank's settlement node may act as the elected coordinator at a time, and coordination follows a leader-election-with-failover pattern: the Campaign action lets any settlement node become the coordinator whenever there currently isn't one, and records the new term as the shared epoch counter advances (up to a fixed cap, after which the epoch number simply stops climbing but elections keep working). The StepDown action lets the current coordinator give up the role at any time, whether because of a handover or a failure, immediately opening the role back up for a fresh election. The CommitSlot action lets the current coordinator lock in the final settlement for one of the still-uncommitted batch slots; this is the one irreversible step in the whole pipeline, since a slot that has already been committed can never be committed again by anyone. The AdminOverride action lets a privileged central-bank administrator commit a still-uncommitted slot directly, without ever having to win an election, but even the administrator is refused once a slot has already been committed. SAFETY PROPERTY: no settlement-batch slot is ever committed more than once, whether the commit came from the elected coordinator or from the administrator's override, and a slot counts as committed exactly when it has a recorded committer. LIVENESS PROPERTY: every settlement-batch slot is eventually committed through the ordinary election-and-coordinator process, no matter how many times coordinators step down and new elections have to be run.
